purpose: Prevent valid authenticated sessions from being trapped on the Studio connection screen when the same-origin data route or an already-consumed OAuth callback is transiently stale.

authentication.oauthReplayRecoveryCondition: Only when a valid persisted session already exists after a consumed/expired OAuth state callback.

studioBootstrap.criticalMembershipTransport: direct Supabase REST with user bearer token and RLS
